teaser.en: A small coastal Grewia that shares its Digo name with a close cousin.
teaser.sw: Grewia ndogo ya pwani inayoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na binamu yake wa karibu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chidide cha Grewia cha pwani, ambacho chinahumira dzina mwenga ra Chidigo na nduguye wa phephi.

summary.en: Mtsaye is Grewia glandulosa, a shrub of the coastal bushland. Pakia records the same Digo name for Grewia vaughanii.
summary.sw: Mtsaye ni Grewia glandulosa, kichaka cha maeneo ya vichaka ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina hilohilo la Kidigo kwa Grewia vaughanii.
summary.dg: Mtsaye ni Grewia glandulosa, chitsaka cha weruni wa pwani. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri piya kpwa Grewia vaughanii.

about.en: Mtsaye is a shrub with alternate, toothed leaves that have three prominent veins from the base, as in all Grewias. It has small star-shaped flowers with narrow petals, followed by small, lobed, berry-like fruits. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsaye ni kichaka chenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu inayoonekana wazi kutoka kwenye kitako, kama ilivyo kwa Grewia zote. Kina maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota na petali nyembamba, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo yenye pindo yanayofanana na beri. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Mtsaye ni chitsaka chenye makodza ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana, gana meno kanda-kanda, na mishipa mihahu inayoonekana waziwazi kula photsi ya kodza, dza irivyo kpwa Grewia zosi. Una maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota genye makodza ga ruwa membamba, na badaye kunatuluka matunda madide ganayoganyika kpwa seemu, ganayohalana na matunda genye madzi manji. Adigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsaye but gives no meaning or shared names. The same name is used for Grewia vaughanii. Its scientific name is Grewia glandulosa.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsaye lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa Grewia vaughanii. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Grewia glandulosa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtsaye, ela kalavya manage wala luga zanjina zinazorihumira. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa piya kpwa Grewia vaughanii. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Grewia glandulosa.
